Admission: Admit Card for Ph.D. Entrance Examination
22 November, 2025
Dear Candidate, Your Admit Card for the Ph.D. Entrance Examination – 2025 is now available for download on the official college admission portal. Date of Exam : 27th November 2025 Reporting Time: 10:00 AM Exam Time : 11:00 AM - 02:00 PM Please follow the steps below to download your admit card: 1. Visit the official website: https://admission.npgc.in/login.aspx 2. Login using your Application ID and Password (Date of Birth in DD/MM/YYYY format). 3. After logging in, you will find the option to print your Admit Card. You are advised to download and print your admit card at the earliest. Thank you
